title: BUG : stuck in temp basal
symptom: After stopping the loop, the basal does not kick in; a temp basal of 0 U/h with duration 4800 minutes is stuck and cannot be cancelled from Actions. The DASH tab shows no temp basal, but the main page shows 0 U/h.
cause: The bug might be related to AAPS restarting; after phone battery died and restart, the duration was 4800 minutes. It was later believed fixed by PR #1715.
fix: Activation of a new DASH solved the problem for one user; another user found that changing profile repeatedly can reset it. The issue was closed as fixed by PR #1715.
evidence_quote: I belive this bug was fixed with https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/1715
